s1.syndrome_frame: Acute onset of respiratory and neurological symptoms with multi-organ involvement and a possible malignant process
salient_findings: Multiple pulmonary nodules and pleural effusion
Left adrenal mass and pelvic mass
key_facts: Diffuse crackles in the upper and lower lung fields
Markedly elevated lactate dehydrogenase of 2764 U/L
Oxygen saturation of 83% to 87% on 6 L nasal cannula
Right atrial mass with prolapse across tricuspid valve
Malignant cells lining vascular spaces on core-needle biopsy of pelvic mass

shortlist.label: Intravascular large B-cell lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: Malignant cells lining vascular spaces and marked elevation of lactate dehydrogenase

shortlist.label: Angiosarcoma of the heart
shortlist.why_kept: Right atrial mass with prolapse across tricuspid valve and malignant cells on biopsy

shortlist.label: Epithelioid hemangioendothelioma
shortlist.why_kept: Malignant vascular tumor consistent with clinical presentation and biopsy findings

shortlist.label: Kaposi's sarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: Multi-organ involvement and possible malignant process with vascular tumor characteristics

shortlist.label: Intravascular lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: Systemic symptoms and multi-organ involvement with malignant lymphoid cells in vascular spaces

raw.rationale: The presence of malignant cells lining vascular spaces on biopsy, along with symptoms such as worsening fatigue, dyspnea, and hemoptysis, and laboratory findings like anemia, thrombocytopenia, and markedly elevated lactate dehydrogenase, are consistent with intravascular large B-cell lymphoma, a rare and aggressive form of lymphoma that often presents with systemic symptoms and multi-organ involvement.

rejected.label: Angiosarcoma of the heart
rejected.why: While the cardiac mass is consistent with angiosarcoma, the biopsy findings of malignant cells lining vascular spaces and the systemic nature of the symptoms are more indicative of intravascular large B-cell lymphoma.

rejected.label: Epithelioid hemangioendothelioma
rejected.why: This is a rare vascular tumor, but the clinical presentation and biopsy findings do not align closely with this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Kaposi's sarcoma
rejected.why: Kaposi's sarcoma typically presents with skin lesions and has a distinct immunohistochemical profile that does not match the provided biopsy results.

rejected.label: Intravascular lymphoma
rejected.why: This is a broader category that includes intravascular large B-cell lymphoma, but given the specific details, intravascular large B-cell lymphoma is a more precise diagnosis.
